name: openclaude
one_liner: A single terminal app for talking to AI coding assistants that works with almost any AI model or provider, so you're not locked into one company's tool.
buyer: A developer or small dev team that wants the flexibility to switch between different AI providers (for cost or capability reasons) without relearning a new tool each time.
business_use_cases: A cost-conscious dev team switches between cheaper and premium AI models per-task using the same interface.
A dev-tools reviewer or educator uses it to demo and compare multiple AI coding agents side by side.
An agency serving clients with different AI-provider preferences standardizes on one tool that supports all of them.

money_ideas.idea: No obvious direct monetization for an outside operator — it's an open interface layer; value would come from paid support or hosted team-management features layered on top.

steal_this: This weekend, build a simple cost-comparison dashboard on top of it that shows a team which AI provider is cheapest for which task type.
